name: Σούγια
evidence: Accessible by car via the paved road connecting the village to Chania; nudist part is the eastern end reached along the beach.

name: Keratokambos
evidence: 12km from Ano Viannos on an asphalt road, perfectly well surfaced; village beach organized.

name: Ρούκουνας
evidence: Access from the main peripheral road then a path; a streamside road was opened by machinery without permit (fined). Not paved to the beach.

name: Ψιλή Άμμος (Σχοινούσα)
evidence: Reached by a track road or boat; 450m dirt path from Messaria; Schinoussa roads mostly dirt.

name: Τούρλος (Αίγινα)
evidence: Access rated Very Easy; bumpy asphalt from Vagia + a short walk. Asphalt exists.

name: Πλάνος (Παξοί)
evidence: Accessible via an UNPAVED road from the outskirts of Lakka; paths not on Google Maps. Not asphalt to the beach.

name: Τραχήλι (Χανιά)
evidence: Could not confirm the Chania beach (only a Chios Trachili found, which is unpaved). OSM shows no paved road + a track → honest-downgrade; possible identity/region issue.

name: Αγία Τριάδα (Ρόδος)
evidence: Easy access with parking nearby, a brief stroll from the parking area (Archangelos/Stegna). Drivable/paved access.

name: Ξεκοφτή (Αγκίστρι)
evidence: Quiet/secluded 1km from Megalochori; no positive confirmation of paved access to the beach (island roads generally OK). Honest-unverified.

name: Άγιος Νικόλαος (Σάμος)
evidence: Small unorganized village beach; no positive paved-access confirmation and OSM shows no paved within 300m. Honest-unverified.

name: Κουμαρά (Φούρνοι)
evidence: Park up the hill and walk down a paved path, OR a downhill difficult DIRT road, or boat. Not easy asphalt to the beach.

name: Kakoudia (Χαλκιδική)
evidence: Turn off the main road onto a DIRT road that leads to the beach; ample parking, unorganized/virgin beach.

name: Βλαχιάς (Εύβοια)
evidence: The real Vlachia beach is reachable only by boat or a hiking path; the side dirt roads to hidden coves are difficult/dead-ends.

name: Άσπρα Χαλίκια (Τριζόνια)
evidence: On Trizonia island — reached by a ~20min walk from the harbor through olive groves; Trizonia is car-free (boat access only). "Asphalt" is wrong.

name: Καψάλες (Τριζόνια)
evidence: On Trizonia — cars are NOT allowed, barely any roads; boat access only. "Asphalt/easy" is wrong.

name: Μονόλιθος (Φωκίδα)
evidence: Could not positively confirm paved access to the Fokida Monolithos (results conflated with Santorini/Rhodes). Honest-unverified.

name: Oasi (Μεσσηνία)
evidence: No positive access confirmation found for the Messinia Oasi; OSM shows no paved within 300m + a track. Honest-unverified.
